headline_marked: BNP MP Ferdousy Ahmed Mishti [[resigns from parliament]] after PM's directive
headline: BNP MP Ferdousy Ahmed Mishti resigns from parliament after PM's directive
summary: The Election Commission will hold a by-election within 90 days to fill the vacant reserved women's seat.
details: BNP lawmaker Ferdousy Ahmed Mishti has resigned from her reserved parliamentary seat following instructions from Prime Minister Tarique Rahman.
The resignation comes amid allegations that Mishti was involved in attacks, looting, and vandalism at the Radda MCH-FP Centre in Dhaka’s Mirpur area.
Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmad confirmed that Mishti submitted her resignation in writing, and the Parliament Secretariat has officially declared seat No. 23 vacant.
Election Commissioner Abdur Rahmanel Masud stated that a by-election will be held within 90 days to fill the vacancy as required by law.
The seat will be allocated to the party or alliance to which it was originally assigned. If only one candidate is nominated, they will be elected unopposed.
Attorney General Kazal noted that the resignation created no legal complications and that Mishti will not be barred from contesting in future elections.
caption:
A BNP lawmaker has resigned from parliament following allegations of involvement in attacks and vandalism in Mirpur.

BNP lawmaker Ferdousy Ahmed Mishti has resigned from her reserved parliamentary seat following instructions from Prime Minister Tarique Rahman.

The resignation comes amid allegations that Mishti was involved in attacks, looting, and vandalism at the Radda MCH-FP Centre in Dhaka’s Mirpur area.

Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmad confirmed that Mishti submitted her resignation in writing, and the Parliament Secretariat has officially declared seat No. 23 vacant.

Election Commissioner Abdur Rahmanel Masud stated that a by-election will be held within 90 days to fill the vacancy as required by law.

The seat will be allocated to the party or alliance to which it was originally assigned. If only one candidate is nominated, they will be elected unopposed.

Attorney General Kazal noted that the resignation created no legal complications and that Mishti will not be barred from contesting in future elections.

Source: bdnews24.com, Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star, Jamuna TV

headline: 3 suspects placed on 3-day remand for New Gini Properties attack
summary: The suspects, including the son-in-law of a former MP, were arrested for allegedly vandalizing a content creator's studio.
details: A Dhaka court has placed three suspects on a three-day remand following an attack on the New Gini Properties residential project. The suspects include Md. Mizanur Rahman, Shahriyar Mahmud, and Md. Shah Alam alias Anik.
caption:
Three men, including the son-in-law of a former MP, are in custody for allegedly vandalizing a content creator's studio.

A Dhaka court has placed three suspects on a three-day remand following an attack on the New Gini Properties residential project. The suspects include Md. Mizanur Rahman, Shahriyar Mahmud, and Md. Shah Alam alias Anik.
